## ArgSpec

```ts
type ArgSpec = z.infer<typeof argumentSpecSchema>
```

A positional argument declared in `tool.toml`.

## BUILTIN_OPTIONS

```ts
const BUILTIN_OPTIONS: readonly OptSpec[]
```

Flags the generated parsers add to every tool, in help order. A manifest option cannot
reuse their long or short names, nor the positive form of a `no-` built-in (`input`),
which Commander would pair with it into one negatable option.

## INTEGER_PATTERN

```ts
const INTEGER_PATTERN
```

The text of every `int` option value the generated parsers accept: ASCII decimal digits, an
optional leading `-`, no `+`, no whitespace and no leading zeros.

## INTEGER_RULE

```ts
const INTEGER_RULE
```

What every parser says when an `int` value is outside `INTEGER_PATTERN` or the safe range.

## ManifestError

```ts
class ManifestError extends Error
```

Error thrown for any invalid or conflicting tool manifest. `fieldPath` is the dotted path
of the failing field (for example `unit.calendar.hour`), or `(root)` when no single field
is at fault. `code` is the errno code (for example `ENOENT`) when `cause` is a system error.

## NAME_PATTERN

```ts
const NAME_PATTERN
```

Valid tool names and aliases: a lowercase letter, then up to 15 lowercase letters, digits or dashes.

## OptSpec

```ts
type OptSpec = z.infer<typeof optSpecSchema>
```

A flag or option declared in `tool.toml`.

## PathCollision

```ts
interface PathCollision
```

A tool name or alias that matches an executable already on PATH.

## RESERVED_COMMANDS

```ts
const RESERVED_COMMANDS: ReadonlySet<string>
```

The tbx subcommands. A tool name or alias cannot be one of them, because `tbx <name>`
dispatches to an installed tool only when `<name>` is not a subcommand.

## assertNoCollisions

```ts
function assertNoCollisions(manifests: ToolManifest[], pathBinaries: string[]): void
```

Ensures every tool name and alias is unique across tools and does not shadow a binary
already on PATH.

- @param manifests the tools to check together.
- @param pathBinaries binary names already present on PATH.
- @throws {ManifestError} naming both owners of the first colliding identifier.

## describePathCollision

```ts
function describePathCollision(collision: PathCollision): string
```

Formats a `PathCollision` as `"<identifier>" collides: <owner> and PATH binary <path>`.

## findPathCollisions

```ts
function findPathCollisions( manifests: ToolManifest[], binaries: readonly { name: string; path: string }[], ): PathCollision[]
```

Lists every name or alias in `manifests` that equals the name of one of `binaries`, in
manifest order.

## loadManifest

```ts
async function loadManifest(path: string): Promise<ToolManifest>
```

Reads and validates a `tool.toml` from disk.

- @throws {ManifestError} when the file cannot be read or is invalid; the message names `path`.

## parseIntegerText

```ts
function parseIntegerText(text: string): number | null
```

Parses an `int` option value: `INTEGER_PATTERN` and at most `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` in
magnitude, so no parser rounds it. Returns `null` for anything else.

## parseManifest

```ts
function parseManifest(toml: string): ToolManifest
```

Parses and validates the text of a `tool.toml`.

- @throws {ManifestError} on TOML syntax errors or schema violations, naming the failing field.
